kind: controlled abstract scene, not calibrated Waymo geometry

coordinates.y: across the road toward the far curb

canvas.annotations: none; labels belong to the native PPT

human.pose: fixed walking pose; no motion between P2 and P3

Uv.type: entire rear cap absent from observation-only surface set
Uv.representation: white opening / very light hatching, dashed extent; no observed blue rear face

Ug.type: road surface occluded by the vehicle throughout the controlled input corridor
Ug.representation: white schematic missing-surface patch with dashed outline; not a physical pothole

Ufar.type: far side +Y absent from observation-only surface set
Ufar.visibility: hidden in P2, exposed in P3; it is already unknown before the camera moves

input_camera_condition: all effective input views remain in front (+X) and on the near side (-Y); centers are a controlled visibility construction, not Waymo calibration

P2.role: external visualization of aggregated surfaces, not a logged camera image

P3.role: change this viewing camera only; retain all world geometry and the same missing-surface set

cameras.P4: reuse P2 camera and all world anchors; add completed geometry only
cameras.P5: vehicle-only crop from the P2 camera before/after completion
cameras.P6a: reuse the P3 camera and the completed P4 scene

invariants: no object translation or rotation between P2/P3
Uv and Ufar move with the vehicle in later vehicle-state examples; Ug stays with the background
no camera symbols, titles, arrows, legend or raster text in the standalone P2 asset
no orange/gold; reserve it for completion in P4/P5/P6
